items.followUp: How is the resultant of two vectors found using the parallelogram rule?

rubric.why: This identifies the correct head-to-tail placement.
rubric.description: Place the tail of the second vector at the head of the first vector, without changing its length or direction.
rubric.how: Award for stating that the second vector’s tail is placed at the first vector’s head.

rubric.why: This gives the correct endpoints and direction of the resultant.
rubric.description: Draw the resultant from the tail of the first vector to the head of the second vector.
rubric.how: Award for identifying both endpoints of the resultant in the correct order.

modelAnswer: Draw the first vector to scale in its given direction.
Place the tail of the second vector at the head of the first vector, keeping its length and direction unchanged.
Draw the resultant from the tail of the first vector to the head of the second vector.
